subject.title: [Bug] Gateway swallows user-visible reply when an agent's exec stdout matches "configuration file" — replies=2 puts ⚠️ 🛠️ first, the actual reply second

question: Should the remaining work preserve core mutating-tool warnings and only clear false/recovered exec warnings, or suppress exec warning finals after successful assistant replies more broadly?
rationale: Current main has the Feishu presentation fix, but the remaining behavior is a user-visible warning policy tradeoff that can hide valid diagnostics if broadened without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow false/recovered warning fix
options.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings while clearing warnings that the trajectory proves came from successful, read-only, or recovered exec activity.

options.title: Accept Feishu coalescing as sufficient
options.body: Treat answer-before-warning presentation as enough if live Feishu proof shows the actual reply remains visible.

options.title: Broaden exec suppression
options.body: Suppress exec warning finals after successful assistant replies across channels, accepting the diagnostic visibility tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Narrow false/recovered warning fix
recommendation.body: Preserve real mutating-tool warnings while clearing warnings that the trajectory proves came from successful, read-only, or recovered exec activity.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the landed Feishu error-final preservation fix and is the clearest routing owner for the remaining Feishu-versus-core warning policy choice.
